steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 1 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 2230 days after the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the ropivacaine hydrochloride shortage on 2018-03-23 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage listing includes Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC with an initial posting date of 2018-03-23.
Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC received an OAI classification letter dated 2024-04-30, which is 2230 days after the shortage posting.
A second OAI classification letter to Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is dated 2024-05-22, 2252 days after the posting.
The Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plant (FEI 1450022) is named on the product label as a registered plant for manufacture and analysis.
Corvale East has 9 days of 2 mg/mL, 20 mL vials on hand and Corvale General has 15 days and can spare 7 vials while keeping two weeks.
The rule-based best option is to transfer 7 vials of 2 mg/mL, 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would bring Corvale East to 10 days on hand.

Q-332013.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('25021065282', '43066001510', '63323028821', '83854001425')
